map.noSnapshotBody: Recorded data appears here as soon as a snapshot is stored. Until then the map shows stations only.
map.tapTrain: Tap a train to see why it is late
map.webglTitle: The map cannot start on this device
map.webglBody: This browser has no WebGL 2, which the map needs. Everything else on this screen still works: the train list below is complete and carries the same as-of time.
map.webglHint: Chrome: Settings → System → turn on “Use graphics acceleration when available”, then relaunch. Firefox and Edge usually work without it.
map.tilesSlow: Map tiles are not loading (offline, or blocked). Trains are listed below.
map.libraryBody: The map library failed to load, which is a problem with this build, not with the trains. Everything below is still live.
map.libraryHint: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, clear the browser cache and reload.

freshness.staleBody: This snapshot is over three hours old. The markers sit exactly where the recording left them, so treat them as history, not as positions now.
freshness.budgetLimited: Serving saved data: today's provider budget is used up.
freshness.replayBody: You are looking at a recording. Trains move as the replay clock advances.

about.title: About RailPulse
about.body: RailPulse shows trains on one corridor at a time, recorded a few times a day, and says how old and how estimated everything is.
about.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with Indian Railways. Estimates must not be used for safety decisions.
about.credits: Train data from RailRadar. Map tiles and data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
about.phases: Phase 1 shows the Delhi–Kanpur corridor. Alerts and more corridors come later.
about.budget: The whole product runs inside 100 provider requests a month.
